disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or attempting to procure a license by fraud, deceit, misrepresentation, misleading omission, or material misstatement of fact
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has procured or attempted to procure a license by fraud, deceit, misrepresentation, misleading omission, or material misstatement of fact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or any crime that would constitute a violation of this part 1
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of a felony or any crime that would constitute a violation of this part 1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in a manner inconsistent with the health or safety of persons under care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has acted in a manner inconsistent with the health or safety of persons under his or her care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license to practice nursing or other health-care occupation suspended or revoked in any jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a license to practice nursing, practice as a certified midwife, or practice any other health-care occupation suspended or revoked in any jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or aiding a violation of any provision of this part 1 or applicable provisions of article 20 or 30
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated or has aided or knowingly permitted any person to violate any provision of this part 1 or an applicable provision of article 20 or 30 of this title 12

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing nursing in a manner that fails to meet generally accepted standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced nursing or as a certified midwife in a manner that fails to meet generally accepted standards for the practice of nursing or as a certified midwife

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any order or rule of the board pertaining to nursing practice or licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any order or rule of the board pertaining to nursing practice, practice as a certified midwife, or licensure

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying or negligently making incorrect entries or failing to make essential entries on patient records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has falsified or in a negligent manner made incorrect entries or failed to make essential entries on patient records

disciplinary_grounds.description: Excessively or habitually using or abusing alcohol, habit-forming drugs, controlled substances, or similar drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Excessively or habitually uses or abuses or has engaged in excessive or habitual use or abuse of alcohol, a habit-forming drug, a controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the board of a physical illness, condition, or behavioral health disorder affecting ability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to: Notify the board, as required by section 12-30-108 (1), of a physical illness, physical condition, or behavioral health, mental health, or substance use disorder that affects the person's ability to practice nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the confidentiality of information or knowledge concerning any patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated the confidentiality of information or knowledge as prescribed by law concerning any patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct constituting a crime relating to employment as a nurse or certified midwife
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any conduct that would constitute a crime as defined in title 18 and that relates to the person's employment as a practical or professional nurse or as a certified midwife.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating abuse of health insurance statutes or advertising to perform prohibited acts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated abuse of health insurance pursuant to section 18-13-119

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully and repeatedly ordering or performing demonstrably unnecessary services without clinical justification
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful and repeated ordering or performance, without clinical justification, of demonstrably unnecessary laboratory tests or studies

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing a fraudulent insurance act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has committed a fraudulent insurance act, as defined in section 10-1-128

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or distributing a controlled substance to oneself or a family member
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has prescribed, distributed, or given to himself or herself or a family member any controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dispensing, injecting, or prescribing anabolic steroids for non-medical purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has dispensed, injected, or prescribed an anabolic steroid... for the purpose of hormonal manipulation that is intended to increase muscle mass, strength, or weight without a medical necessity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing habit-forming drugs or controlled substances outside legitimate professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has administered, dispensed, or prescribed any habit-forming drug or any controlled substance... other than in the course of legitimate professional practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being disciplined by another state, territory, or country for conduct substantially the same as grounds for discipline here
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been disciplined by another state, territory, or country based upon an act or omission that is defined substantially the same as a ground for discipline pursuant to this subsection (1)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to respond in a materially factual and timely manner to a complaint
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully fails to respond in a materially factual and timely manner to a complaint issued pursuant to section 12-255-119 (3)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to accurately complete and submit the board's renewal questionnaire
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to accurately complete and submit to the board the designated questionnaire upon renewal of a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing oneself as a licensed nurse or certified midwife without holding such a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Represents oneself to an individual or to the general public by use of any word or abbreviation to indicate or induce others to believe that he or she is a licensed practical or professional nurse unless the person is actually licensed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing as a nurse or certified midwife while license is suspended, revoked, or on inactive status
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practices as a practical or professional nurse or as a certified midwife during a period when the person's license has been suspended, revoked, or placed on inactive status

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling or fraudulently obtaining or furnishing a nursing or certified midwife license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sells or fraudulently obtains or furnishes a license to practice as a nurse or certified midwife or aids or abets in such act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report a criminal conviction to the board within thirty days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to report to the board, within thirty days after a final conviction, that the person has been convicted of a crime, as defined in title 18

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain required professional liability insurance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to maintain professional liability insurance in accordance with section 12-255-113

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a sexual act with a patient during or within six months following professional relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in a sexual act with a patient during the course of patient care or within six months immediately following the termination of the person's professional relationship with the patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the board of a malpractice judgment or settlement within thirty days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to notify the board, in writing and within thirty days after a judgment or settlement is entered, of a final judgment by a court of competent jurisdiction against the licensee for malpractice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report adverse action by another licensing agency or peer review body within thirty days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to report to the board, within thirty days after an adverse action, that an adverse action has been taken against the person by another licensing agency in another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report surrender of a license in another state while under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to report to the board, within thirty days, the surrender of a license or other authorization to practice nursing or as a certified midwife in another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diverting controlled substances or drugs from the place of employment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is diverting or has diverted a controlled substance... or any other drug having similar effects from the person's place of employment

insurance_required.quote: It is unlawful for any advanced practice registered nurse or certified midwife engaged in an independent practice of professional nursing or as a certified midwife to practice within the state of Colorado unless the advanced practice registered nurse or certified midwife purchases and maintains or is covered by professional liability insurance in an amount not less than five hundred thousand dollars per claim

definition_quote.value: Practice of professional nursing means the delivery of independent and collaborative nursing care to individuals of all ages, families, groups, and communities, whether sick or well, in all settings. The functions include the initiation and performance of nursing care through health promotion, supportive or restorative care, disease prevention, diagnosis and treatment of human disease, ailment, pain, injury, deformity, and physical or mental condition using specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill involving the application of biological, physical, social, and behavioral science principles required for licensure as a professional nurse.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of professional nursing" means the delivery of independent and collaborative nursing care to individuals of all ages, families, groups, and communities, whether sick or well, in all settings.

value: diagnosis and treatment of human disease, ailment, pain, injury, deformity, and physical or mental condition
evaluating health status through collection and assessment of health data
providing therapy and treatment supportive and restorative to life and well-being
executing delegated medical functions and delegated patient care functions
referring patients to medical or community agencies
reviewing and monitoring therapy and treatment plans
methods_authorized.quote: The "practice of professional nursing" includes the performance of such services as: Evaluating health status through the collection and assessment of health data; Health teaching and health counseling; Providing therapy and treatment that is supportive and restorative to life and well-being either directly to the patient or indirectly through consultation with, delegation to, supervision of, or teaching of others; Executing delegated medical functions and delegated patient care functions; Referring to medical or community agencies those patients who need further evaluation or treatment; Reviewing and monitoring therapy and treatment plans.

drug_authority.value: APRNs and certified midwives may be authorized to prescribe controlled substances and prescription drugs upon meeting requirements including graduate degree, national certification, professional liability insurance, and completion of a prescribing mentorship of 750 hours. Prescribing is limited to the nurse's role and population focus. An APRN registered in the advanced practice registry is not required to obtain prescriptive authority.
drug_authority.quote: The board may authorize the following licensees to prescribe controlled substances or prescription drugs... An advanced practice registered nurse who is listed on the advanced practice registry, who has a license in good standing without disciplinary sanctions issued pursuant to section 12-255-110, and who has fulfilled the requirements of this section

value: Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - includes CNM, CNS, CRNA, NP
license_tiers.quote: "Practical nurse"... means a person who holds a license to practice pursuant to this part 1 as a licensed practical nurse... "Registered nurse" or "registered professional nurse" means a professional nurse... "Advanced practice registered nurse" means a registered professional nurse who is licensed to practice pursuant to this part 1... "Certified midwife" means an individual who meets the qualifications for practice as a certified midwife... "Certified nurse aide" means a person who meets the qualifications specified in part 2

aprn_role_categories.quote: A registered professional nurse who is included in the advanced practice registry has the right to use the title "advanced practice registered nurse" or, if authorized by the board, to use the title "certified nurse midwife", "clinical nurse specialist", "certified registered nurse anesthetist", or "nurse practitioner".

value: licensed health-care provider authorized to practice in this state
lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "Practice of practical nursing" means the performance, under the supervision of a licensed health-care provider authorized to practice in this state

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse shall practice in accordance with the standards of the appropriate national professional nursing organization and have a safe mechanism for consultation or collaboration with a physician or, when appropriate, referral to a physician.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: Nothing in this part 1: Prohibits any licensee from practicing practical or professional nursing or as a certified midwife independently for compensation upon a fee for services basis

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: The board may authorize the following licensees to prescribe controlled substances or prescription drugs... An advanced practice registered nurse who is listed on the advanced practice registry, who has a license in good standing without disciplinary sanctions issued pursuant to section 12-255-110, and who has fulfilled the requirements of this section

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: APRNs and certified midwives with prescriptive authority are subject to the limitations on prescriptions specified in section 12-30-109, which limits initial prescriptions to a 7-day supply for new opioid patients, with exceptions for chronic pain, cancer pain, post-surgical pain expected to last more than 14 days, and palliative/hospice care.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse or a certified midwife with prescriptive authority pursuant to this section is subject to the limitations on prescriptions specified in section 12-30-109.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Each prescriber licensed in this state who holds a current registration issued by the federal drug enforcement administration shall register and maintain a user account as specified in section 12-280-403.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: The board shall maintain a registry of all certified nurse aides and a record of all final disciplinary action taken against persons under this article 255.

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: Prior to a certified nurse aide obtaining authority as a medication aide to administer medications, the certified nurse aide shall meet all applicable requirements as established by rules of the board.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: Any licensed practical nurse, registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, or certified midwife may delegate any task included in the nurse's or certified midwife's licensed scope of practice... A licensed practical nurse, registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, or certified midwife may delegate nursing or certified midwife tasks to licensed, certified, registered, or unlicensed or unregulated assistive personnel.

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: The employer shall report the disciplinary action or resignation to the board.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: To facilitate the licensure of nurses under the "Enhanced Nurse Licensure Compact", part 38 of article 60 of title 24

multistate_license_option_available.quote: To facilitate the licensure of nurses under the "Enhanced Nurse Licensure Compact", part 38 of article 60 of title 24

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: As a condition of licensure and for the purpose of supporting a peer health assistance program for nurses or certified midwives or an alternative to discipline program for nurses or certified midwives, every applicant for an initial license or to reinstate a license and any person renewing a license issued pursuant to this part 1 shall pay to the administering entity designated pursuant to subsection (3)(c) of this section a fee

nurse_practitioner_transition_to_practic.quote: Once the provisional prescriptive authority is granted, the advanced practice registered nurse or certified midwife must obtain seven hundred fifty hours of documented experience in a mutually structured prescribing mentorship

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse or a certified midwife may be granted authority to prescribe prescription drugs and controlled substances to provide treatment to clients within the role and population focus of the advanced practice registered nurse or certified midwife
